title: CLASH: EVALUATING LANGUAGE MODELS ON JUDGING HIGH-STAKES DILEMMAS FROM MULTIPLE PERSPECTIVES

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the base preference of models when judging high-stakes moral dilemmas without explicit steering, and mapping their responses to specific value frameworks (e.g., Moral Foundations Theory, Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs) to quantify inherent alignments toward certain values (e.g., prioritizing Safety over Self-Esteem).
